title: 7.7 Invitations and Responses
unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
unit_outcome: Handle basic physical needs, weather, clothing, leisure, invitations, and requests for help.
lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
goal: Understand a simple Do you want to...? invitation and accept or decline with familiar polite chunks.
grammar_function: Do you want to + known activity? Yes, thank you. / Sorry, no.
prerequisite: 5.5 wants; 6.7 Yes and Sorry, no; 7.6 hobbies.
speaking_outcome: Say three simple invitations and both polite responses.
